Impact: high (draft)Automatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Global Trade Management · Redwood UI

Inline Edit Always Shows External ID (XID)

Impact: medium (draft)Automatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Global Trade Management · Enhanced Workbench Improvements

Multi-Day Calendar Overrides

Impact: medium (draft)Automatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Transportation Management · Usability Enhancements
The Multi-Day Calendar Override feature allows you to define both a start date and time and an end date and time for your calendar override entries. With the addition of the end date, you can now apply closures or schedule exceptions across a continuous date range without needing to create multiple records.

Impact: medium (draft)Automatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Transportation Management · Document Management

Honor Expiry Date Range Rules for Cross Dock Pick And Allocate

Impact: medium (draft)Automatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Inventory Operations
Pick and Allocate now validates picked inventory against an Expiry Date Range rule before allocation. A new mobile screen parameter , Expiry Date Range Rule, controls this behaviour.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Honor Expiry Date Range Rules for Direct Allocation

Impact: medium (draft)Automatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Inventory Operations
Direct Allocation now supports expiry date validation during allocation. A new screen parameter, Expiry Date Range Rule , lets customers define which expiry date range rule WMS applies when users allocate inventory from a scanned LPN or pallet to an order.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Honor Expiry Date Range, Order Prioritization Rules for Distribute LPN

Impact: medium (draft)Automatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Inventory Operations
Warehouses use flowthrough to move received inventory directly to outbound orders instead of storing it first. When several orders can receive the same inventory, users need a consistent way to decide which inventory should flow through and which order should receive it.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Improve Receiving Execution with Shipment Progress Visibility in Mobile

Impact: medium (draft)Automatically onLogistics (OTM/GTM/WMS)Warehouse Management · Inbound Logistics
Warehouse operators and supervisors can now view real-time shipment receiving progress directly within Mobile receiving transactions. The enhancement provides shipment-level visibility into key receiving metrics, allowing users to monitor receiving progress without navigating to other screens or running reports.
